statement: Assume the hypotheses of Proposition 3.1. Let P ∈ Bs(k) and let A ∈ T∗ P Bs be non-nilpotent. There exist a point x ∈ X(k), a cocharacter λ, a modification h ∈ Hλ s (k) from P to a bundle P′, and a covector θ = (A′ , ξ) ∈ T∗ (P′,x)(Bs × X), ξ ̸= 0, 16 such that A′ agrees with A away from x and dp∗ hA = dq∗ hθ. (4.2) Moreover, form the fixed-side fibers Hin P,x = e p−1 (P, x), Hout P′,x = q−1 (P′ , x), with the fixed-bundle identifications retained. On the first fiber, restriction of p∗A to the q-relative tangent bundle defines a section SA of ΩHs/Zs,q. On the second fiber, restriction of o∗A′ to the e p-relative tangent bundle similarly defines SA′ . Both sections vanish at h, and both derivatives (dSA)h : ThHin P,x −→ (ThHout P′,x)∗ , (dSA′ )h : ThHout P′,x −→ (ThHin P,x)∗ are isomorphisms. In particular, each section has an isolated reduced zero at h.
